final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN product_price IS NOT NULL THEN product_price END) as mean_price, COUNT(*) as line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN mean_price IS NOT NULL THEN mean_price END) as avg_of_mean_prices, AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_items FROM invoice_stats
